subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should raw token, cost, and quota usage become part of `session_status.details`, move into a separate agent-facing usage tool, or remain only on Gateway/operator usage surfaces for now?
rationale: The source gap is confirmed, but the stable API boundary affects transcripts, provider quota windows, cost authority, visibility, privacy, freshness, and compatibility semantics.

options.title: Add session_status usage details
options.body: Extend `session_status.details` with stable session, last-turn, budget/window, source, freshness, and unavailable metadata while preserving the rendered status card.

options.title: Create a separate usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-oriented and add a narrower agent-facing usage query tool under the same visibility guards.

options.title: Keep usage operator-only
options.body: Leave raw usage on Gateway/operator surfaces until broader usage-ledger and freshness designs settle.

recommendation.title: Add session_status usage details
recommendation.body: Extend `session_status.details` with stable session, last-turn, budget/window, source, freshness, and unavailable metadata while preserving the rendered status card.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the tool and have the strongest history signal on the `session_status` contract.
